params.1273: Given by any seer in Seers' Village for completing all Easy Tasks in Seers' Village.
params.1292: Seers' headband 1 and a magic lamp worth 1,000xp in a skill of your choice. The coal trucks at the Seers' Village coal mine will now hold 140 coal.
params.1274: The headband confers the following benefits:
params.1275: - Provides a constant source of weak light (subsequent headbands will provide stronger light).
params.1276: - 100% chance of receiving two logs when cutting normal trees.
params.1277: Geoffrey in the flax field near Seers' Village will give you 30 flax per day.
